column1: # Relations that hold BETWEEN cases. Columns: case-a <TAB> case-b <TAB> relation
#   same    the two inputs MUST canonicalize to identical bytes (isomorphism)
#   differ  the two inputs MUST canonicalize to different bytes
# The two folded cases (profile §3.1) spell ONE statement-layer row each. Folding
# reads that row and nothing more: it never fabricates the asserted triple the genuine
# fixture also carries, so the spelled row and the full structure stay distinct.
# Version 4. `flat-same` / `flat-differ` run both inputs under the standard flat
# composite-blanks option, and `option-differs` runs the left input under the standard
# flat presentation and the right under the option.
# A blank label inside a composite lexical form is text under flat: renaming it changes the bytes.
# Under the named option it is a blank node of the graph: renaming it does not.
# A reserved IRI outside a fold shape is the line it is written as: no two of these share bytes.
